title: Teen Killed in Torrance Shooting Identified as Recent Culver City High School Graduate - NewsBreak
text: CULVER CITY - A recent Culver City High School graduate who was shot and killed at a graduation party in Torrance has been identified as 17-year-old Chyler Paton, according to the Los Angeles County Medical Examiner. Paton died from a gunshot wound to the head, officials said. He was pronounced dead at the scene despite paramedics' attempts to save him. Officers with the Torrance Police Department responded to reports of gunfire in the 23000 block of Huber Avenue, near Sepulveda Boulevard and Walnut Street, late last week. When officers arrived, they found shell casings and Paton unresponsive. He was declared dead at the scene. Investigators said the shooting occurred at a pool party following Paton's high school graduation. No arrests have been made, and the investigation remains ongoing. Paton, who had recently completed four years on the Culver City High School football team, was preparing to attend California State University, Dominguez Hills this fall. His death has shaken the local community. On Tuesday night, hundreds gathered on the Culver City High School football field for a candlelight vigil in Paton's honor. Police estimated between 200 and 300 attendees. During the vigil, a fight broke out and shots were fired near campus, according to the Culver City Police Department. No injuries were reported. Authorities held a press conference Wednesday to address both Paton's death and the vigil incident. Police have not confirmed whether the two shootings are connected. A GoFundMe campaign launched to support Paton's mother, identified as Ty, has raised funds to help with funeral and family expenses. Organizers described Paton as "a loving son, brother, classmate, and teammate," calling him a "rising star" whose life was tragically cut short. "His unexpected passing has left not only his family, but his friends and our community devastated," the fundraiser stated. "Let's come together to help with her family's large expenses during this time."
